Use-case specifics / requirements (copied from notes):
- "We need identical completions when pinned to model@vX.Y — regardless of hardware or minor backend optimizations."
- Must support deterministic seeding + stable tokenization across releases.
- Rollout policy: staged canary -> 10% internal -> 25% beta orgs -> 100%. Automatic rollback on eval gate failure.
- Eval gates: perf (p99 latency), functional (token-match on curated prompt set), and quality regression thresholds (no more than 2% drop in dev-acceptance rate).
- Streaming: chunked-by-token streaming with <50ms first-byte and tail-latency target p95 <120ms for completion segments.
- Cost sensitivity: medium-high — prefer quantized variants for non-critical completions, but require reproducibility guarantees for canonical completions.
